湾区搬家最容易乱的地方，是你以为“找个搬家公司”就够了。现实里通常是一整串事一起: A Bay Area move gets complicated when you assume hiring movers is enough. Often, everything happens together: leaving the old place, collecting new keys, handling used furniture, deciding what to move, cleaning, and handing over keys. Getting the sequence right helps.
先决定这是整屋搬，还是轻搬: First decide whether this is a full household move or a light move
房间搬房间：重点是打包、少量家具和室友交接。: Moving from one room to another: focus on packing, a few furniture items, and roommate handover.
整屋搬家：重点是时间协调、搬家公司、停车和楼层。: Whole-home move: Focus on timing, movers, parking, and floors.
首次入住：重点是家具家电、送货、安装和基础清洁。: Moving into your first place: focus on furniture, appliances, delivery, installation, and basic cleaning.
退租换房：重点是旧家交接和新家同步推进。: Changing rentals: Coordinate the old-home handover and new-home setup.

找搬家服务时，别只看“多少钱一小时”: When hiring movers, look beyond the hourly rate
是否需要拆装。: Whether disassembly or assembly is needed.
是否需要打包材料或额外人工。: Whether packing supplies or extra workers are needed.
只看一个很低的报价，后面再被加时长、加楼层、加材料费，通常不会更省。: A very low quote followed by extra charges for time, floors, and materials usually doesn't save money.
旧家要先想“怎么退”，不是只想“怎么走”: Plan how to hand back the old home, not just how to leave it
如果你有押金、室友分账、家具转让、清洁责任，这些事最好在搬家前几天就开始收尾。把: If a deposit, shared bills, furniture transfer, or cleaning responsibilities are involved, start wrapping them up a few days before moving. Plan photos, cleaning, key handover, and trash removal to reduce explanations later.
新家别等搬进去才发现什么都没有: Don't wait until move-in to discover the new place has nothing ready
床或临时睡眠方案。: A bed or temporary sleeping arrangement.
桌椅和基础照明。: A table, chairs, and basic lighting.
洗漱、垃圾袋、纸巾、清洁用品。: Toiletries, trash bags, tissues, and cleaning supplies.
网络或手机热点备用。: Internet or a backup phone hotspot.
锅、碗、烧水壶等基础厨房用品。: Basic kitchen items such as pots, bowls, and a kettle.
二手家具很适合在搬家节点一起解决: A move is a useful time to arrange used furniture
很多东西不一定值得从旧家搬到新家，也不是所有东西都该买新的。桌子、书架、餐桌、灯: Not everything is worth moving, and not everything needs to be bought new. Desks, bookshelves, dining tables, and lamps often work well secondhand locally. Mattresses, refrigerators, and washing machines need more careful checks.
搬家这件事，真正让人崩溃的通常不是大事，而是当晚没床、第二天没网、旧家还没拍照、: The most frustrating moving problems are often small: no bed that night, no internet the next day, no photos of the old place, and no lights in the new one. Split the work into four tracks: old home, new home, transport, and furniture.
